comments.body: Concur that the current client snippet may not be representative. Will take some of your snippet, though the client provider abstraction I think doesn't make as much sense in a worker context and so we may be able to remove it to simplify the snippet.
Added admittedly-naive sample that uses file watcher to refresh certs in #617. Anything more complicated may deserve a project in `samples-dotnet`.

title: [Bug] Worker Client Refresh example is confusing as it doesn't have a need for client refresh
